title: Choose between result kinds
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Choose between result kinds. Visit /score/-1.
introduction: IActionResult allows different outcomes. GET /score/8 returns a success; a negative score returns 400.
learningObjectives: Choose between result kinds with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Choose between result kinds

blocks.text: The positive route number bypasses BadRequest. The success branch returns score 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check invalid input before returning a success result.
